paragraphs: Elyehoeinai ben HaKof: Mishnah Parah 3:5. Hyman reports that the Mishnah of the Westerners reads HaKayaf.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The phrase “Mishnah of the Westerners” is retained as Hyman’s designation; no particular manuscript or recension is identified by this translation.

The whole Torat Emet 357 Mishnah Parah 3:5 explicitly names Elyehoeinai ben HaKof. The HaKayaf alternative and the designation Mishnah of the Westerners remain Hyman’s report; that recension was not freshly collated or identified. The current note remains verbatim and no extra priestly genealogy or narrative is imported.
